data: Microsoft reported diluted earnings per share of $11.80 for fiscal 2024 (year ended June 30, 2024), up from $9.68 in fiscal 2023 (year ended June 30, 2023). That is an increase of $2.12 per share, or about 21.9%. Net income for fiscal 2024 was $88,136 million (about $88.1 billion), up from $72,361 million in fiscal 2023. These figures come from the income statement in Microsoft's fiscal 2024 Form 10-K, filed July 30, 2024.
